eventtitle: Building autonomous AI at scale with Amazon Bedrock
description: Building autonomous AI at scale with Amazon Bedrock marks a breakthrough for autonomous AI systems, from vibe coding to specialized assistants and super-agents disrupting multi-billion dollar industries. Amazon Bedrock empowers disruptive startups to rapidly prototype autonomous applications and agents, seamlessly scaling from proof-of-concept to production systems serving millions of users. We'll tackle top scaling challenges, share best practices, from rapid MVP development to handling production traffic at scale. Discover specific Bedrock capabilities and support programs that optimize performance, reduce cost, achieve global scalability, and enable your vision without enterprise-level infrastructure investments.
